taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-01 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1056.4 | 23.97 | 23.97
2 | 1090.4 | 1.46 | 25.43
3 | 2606.8 | 3.17 | 28.60
4 | 3560.6 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as A-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-01
Curve type: A-type
Aquifer depth: 23.97 m – 28.60 m
Recommendation: The intermediate layers between 23.97 m and 28.60 m (moderately resistive, likely weathered/fractured zone) represent the best groundwater target; drill through the shallow overburden with casing and screen this interval, while noting that the underlying high-resistivity layer (>3500 ohm-m) likely represents dense, poorly water-bearing bedrock and may be used as the drilling termination horizon.
